schema.title: Datum
schema.description: The state (instance tokens), an owned object's Holding (0x4f tokens), or a keyed list's head, node or retired node (0x4b tokens)

tokens.keyed: 0x4b ++ blake2b_224(instance ++ typeId ++ key), 29 bytes; a list head's key is empty

encoding.note: inline datums are canonical CBOR: map keys sorted (SortedMaps); records are constructor 0

json.integer: a decimal string (or a safe JavaScript integer)
json.constructor: an object by field title; a sum type adds "$variant" (its constructor title)
json.Optional: null for None, else the value
json.map: an array of [key, value] pairs, in canonical key order
json.Data: hex CBOR of any Plutus data
